summary.text: At level L1, a test reproduced the CONNECT host/port parsing failure before the fix and passed after it, with no regressions found and no breaking inputs from Break My Fix, but the fix was not guarded: the tests did not kill enough mutants to reach L2. The most important next step is to strengthen tests around the changed parsing lines (e.g., CONNECT targets like 'host:443' across Python versions…

                 self.host = self.url.scheme
-                self.port = 443 if self.url.path == b'' else \
+                self.port = 80 if self.url.path == b'' else \
                     int(self.url.path)
